info.title: Queue OpenAPI for fal-ai/z-image/turbo/image-to-image
info.description: The OpenAPI schema for the fal-ai/z-image/turbo/image-to-image queue.

x-fal-metadata.about: Generate images using Z-Image Turbo with Image-to-Image at lightning speed.

image_size.description: The size of the generated image.
image_size.title: Image Size

examples: A young Asian woman with long, vibrant purple hair stands on a sunlit sandy beach, posing confidently with her left hand resting on her hip. She gazes directly at the camera with a neutral expression. A sleek black ribbon bow is tied neatly on the right side of her head, just above her ear. She wears a flowing white cotton dress with a fitted bodice and a flared skirt that reaches mid-calf, slightly lifted by a gentle sea breeze. The beach behind her features fine, pale golden sand with subtle footprints, leading to calm turquoise waves under a clear blue sky with soft, wispy clouds. The lighting is natural daylight, casting soft shadows to her left, indicating late afternoon sun. The horizon line is visible in the background, with a faint silhouette of distant dunes. Her skin tone is fair with a natural glow, and her facial features are delicately defined. The composition is centered on her figure, framed from mid-thigh up, with shallow depth of field blurring the distant waves slightly.
prompt.description: The prompt to generate an image from.
prompt.title: Prompt

sync_mode.description: If `True`, the media will be returned as a data URI and the output data won't be available in the request history.
sync_mode.title: Sync Mode

output_format.description: The format of the generated image.
output_format.title: Output Format

num_inference_steps.description: The number of inference steps to perform.
num_inference_steps.title: Number of Inference Steps

enable_prompt_expansion.description: Whether to enable prompt expansion. Note: this will increase the price by 0.0025 credits per request.
enable_prompt_expansion.title: Enable Prompt Expansion

seed.description:
The same seed and the same prompt given to the same version of the model
            will output the same image every time.
seed.title: Seed

strength.description: The strength of the image-to-image conditioning.
strength.title: Strength

num_images.description: The number of images to generate.
num_images.title: Number of Images

image_url.description: URL of Image for Image-to-Image generation.
image_url.title: Image URL

enable_safety_checker.description: If set to true, the safety checker will be enabled. Disabling it requires account authorization; unauthorized requests are always checked, and images flagged as unsafe are returned as black images.
enable_safety_checker.title: Enable Safety Checker

timings.description: The timings of the generation process.
timings.title: Timings

seed.description: Seed of the generated Image. It will be the same value of the one passed in the input or the randomly generated that was used in case none was passed.
seed.title: Seed

has_nsfw_concepts.description: Whether the generated images contain NSFW concepts.
has_nsfw_concepts.title: Has Nsfw Concepts

prompt.description: The prompt used for generating the image.
prompt.title: Prompt

width.description: The width of the generated image.
width.title: Width

height.description: The height of the generated image.
height.title: Height

url.description: The URL where the file can be downloaded from.
url.title: Url

content_type.description: The mime type of the file.
content_type.title: Content Type

file_name.description: The name of the file. It will be auto-generated if not provided.
file_name.title: File Name

file_size.description: The size of the file in bytes.
file_size.title: File Size

schema.description: Whether to include logs (`1`) in the response or not (`0`).

success.description: Whether the request was cancelled successfully.
